item.title: Fix bug in window.py so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local chat): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Requirements: find the bug in window.py by running `python3 -m unittest` and reading the failures; fix the root cause in window.py; do not modify any test files; make the function correct for all valid inputs (check edge cases such as empty input, single element, boundary values, and window sizes at the limits), not just the tested ones; add no unrelated changes. Commit the fix locally with a clear message. Do not push.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py sliding_windows. The window count was len(items) - size, which dropped the final window; it is now len(items) - size + 1. Commit 3fa980de93ed294b754cfc3064eaef8b53c7d865 on archon/bhgryv68-fix-bug-in-window-py-so-python3-m-unitte, tree 86fa2570260a2e082a57848f99c47518a99b485c. Only window.py changed; no test files touched; not pushed. Checks: python3 -B -m unittest ran 3 tests, OK (before the fix: 2 failures). Ad-hoc edge checks passed: [] with size 1, [1] with size 1, size equal to len gives one window, size greater than len gives [], empty input gives [], size 0 and -1 still raise ValueError. pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every window again. now includes the final window and returns [] when size > len. before: last window dropped, now: all windows returned
